changelog: v0.6.0 (Build 47): 1) Local WebAssembly (WASM) Server AI Pipeline: Powered by local WASM models (Whisper STT, SmolLM2/Qwen LLMs, Piper Neural TTS) running directly in Node.js on PC multi-core CPU without external dependencies; 2) Tri-Model Catalog & Remote Selection: Quest 3 settings dynamically queries PC server WASM models (/api/models) and lets user choose STT, LLM, and TTS models; 3) Agentic Process & Tooling: Fixed natural Whisper speech matcher for time, battery, and world control queries; eliminated canned placeholder responses; 4) 300 automated tests passing with zero failures.
